classification_basis.final_package_gate_requirement: The exact final package HEAD, including reviewer documentation, must independently rerun both gates before review or acceptance.
classification_basis.note: The executable anchor proves owner-controlled source/poll authority; generation-and-dataset-revision-bound owner-current history coverage; atomic provider dataset revision/invalidation on owner-visible INSERT/UPDATE; fail-closed identity rewrite, DELETE and TRUNCATE behavior; worker exclusion from direct provider mutation/trigger administration; anti-orphan execution of all current history hardening modules; stable reconciliation identities validated before provider-time windowing; ID-only authenticated-principal single-winner PITR recovery authority; genuine fresh-cluster Timescale reconstruction; lock-before-F source fencing; deterministic self-delimiting structured cryptographic representations whose typed timestamptz and unconstrained numeric values have total/injective full-domain canonical forms including AD/BC, timestamp infinity/-infinity and numeric NaN/Infinity/-Infinity; target-originated target-only checkpoint signing authority; Tier 1 verification without mint capability; restricted verifier capability state; caller-local post-connect deadlines; durable Tier 1 activation grants; target promotion only after exact grant verification; no uncheckpointed pre-activation target history; seal-vs-DML serialization; and atomic rollback of placement+grant commitment on injected conflict.

late_history_evidence.worker: history_reconcile_worker NOLOGIN with EXECUTE only on governed sweep/finalize surfaces and no direct provider-history mutation/trigger-admin authority
late_history_evidence.sweep_authority: worker supplies only window plus expected owner authority; actual generation, dataset revision and provider snapshot are read and locked from provider_authority
late_history_evidence.finalization_authority: try_finalize accepts no caller authority/finality/currentness values; it reads and locks current authority_generation, provider_dataset_revision, finality and required snapshot from provider_authority
late_history_evidence.stale_worker: rejected when expected authority differs from durable current owner state
late_history_evidence.coverage_generation: only reconciliation_run rows whose authority_generation equals the exact currently locked owner generation are eligible
late_history_evidence.coverage_dataset_revision: only reconciliation_run rows whose provider_dataset_revision equals the exact currently locked owner dataset revision are eligible
late_history_evidence.generation_transition: every authority-generation advance clears materialized coverage and moves non-gap state to reconciliation_required even if snapshot/finality/currentness timestamps are unchanged
late_history_evidence.provider_mutation_invalidation: owner-visible INSERT/UPDATE increments provider_dataset_revision and invalidates materialized coverage atomically in the same transaction; rollback reverts both mutation and revision bump
late_history_evidence.provider_mutation_serialization: provider mutation trigger and sweep both lock the same provider_authority row so a same-generation correction cannot race past a just-published coverage state
late_history_evidence.destructive_mutation_policy: stable identity rewrite rejects; DELETE fails closed requiring explicit gap authority; statement-level TRUNCATE has a separate BEFORE TRUNCATE fail-closed guard
late_history_evidence.history_runner_completeness_guard: workflow enumerates existing 00[4-9]_history_*.sql files and fails if any are not referenced by run_conformance_extended.sh; exact anchor reports history_modules=4
late_history_evidence.coverage_semantics: only overlapping/touching runs from exact current authority generation and exact current provider dataset revision whose durable provider_snapshot_at satisfies owner-required currentness form continuous coverage
late_history_evidence.stable_identity_content: existing accepted (stream_id,observation_id) content is immutable; owner-visible observed_at or numeric_value mismatch rejects before reconciliation_run
late_history_evidence.cross_window_identity_validation: stable identity conflict validation precedes provider-time insertion filtering whenever accepted or owner-current timestamp intersects the requested window
late_history_evidence.conflict_failure_atomicity: rejected conflicting sweep preserves accepted canonical content and does not mint coverage
late_history_evidence.unrecoverable_retention_loss: explicit durable gap; never false complete

recovery_evidence.restore_boundary: physical PostgreSQL PITR to committed R
recovery_evidence.surviving_authority: separate external control PostgreSQL not included in source backup/restore
recovery_evidence.grant_storage: structured typed columns plus canonical payload, attestation, claimed authenticated principal and claim timestamp
recovery_evidence.grant_canonical_field_encoding: UTF-8 byte length in decimal + ':' + lowercase UTF-8 hex
recovery_evidence.grant_canonicalization: all structured fields independently self-delimiting before HMAC-SHA-256
recovery_evidence.grant_authentication: HMAC-SHA-256 with random key generated and stored only in surviving external authority
recovery_evidence.claim_api: claim_grant(grant_id) and verify_claimed_grant(grant_id); no caller-supplied target/principal identity or signed grant facts
recovery_evidence.credential_spoof_negative: rival password cannot authenticate under winning recovery principal role name
recovery_evidence.grant_claim_semantics: first authenticated session principal claims under row lock; same-principal retry true; different authenticated principal false
recovery_evidence.grant_claim_concurrency: two independently authenticated principals race one grant; exactly one winner required
recovery_evidence.evidence_identity_mechanism: PostgreSQL LOGIN/password sessions provisioned after restore reaches R

relocation_evidence.source_fence_derivation: placement authority locked before F is derived
relocation_evidence.source_inflight_acceptance_race: acceptance holding placement lock commits before fence and is included in F
relocation_evidence.canonical_field_encoding: UTF-8 byte length in decimal + ':' + lowercase UTF-8 hex
relocation_evidence.canonical_timestamp_encoding: finite: UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH24:MI:SS.USZ plus explicit AD/BC era; non-finite: exact reserved -infinity or infinity literal before canonical_field framing
relocation_evidence.timestamp_era_negative: 0001-01-01 BC and 0001-01-01 AD canonical timestamps are distinct on both authorities
relocation_evidence.timestamp_nonfinite_negative: -infinity and infinity canonical timestamps are nonempty, distinct and exact on both authorities
relocation_evidence.canonical_timestamp_cross_store: PostgreSQL and Timescale canonical_timestamp produce identical values for same supported timestamp
relocation_evidence.nonfinite_timestamp_digest: canonical fields for -infinity and infinity are cross-store equal but distinct and produce distinct SHA-256 digests
relocation_evidence.digest_total_timestamp_canonicalizer: authoritative_digest and target_digest are statically verified to call canonical_timestamp before canonical_field
relocation_evidence.canonical_numeric_encoding: finite numeric uses trim_scale(value)::text; special values use exact reserved NaN, Infinity and -Infinity literals before canonical_field framing
relocation_evidence.numeric_special_values_negative: NaN, Infinity and -Infinity are nonempty, mutually distinct and exactly represented on both authorities
relocation_evidence.canonical_numeric_cross_store: PostgreSQL and Timescale canonical_numeric produce identical canonical finite and special-value representations
relocation_evidence.special_numeric_digest: canonical fields for NaN, Infinity and -Infinity are cross-store equal but mutually distinct and produce distinct SHA-256 digests
relocation_evidence.digest_total_numeric_canonicalizer: authoritative_digest and target_digest are statically verified to call canonical_numeric before canonical_field
relocation_evidence.canonical_serialization: ordered rows; every field self-delimiting; row concatenation uses no delimiter as authority boundary
relocation_evidence.canonical_payload_fingerprint: SHA-256 over deterministic self-delimiting canonical observation serialization
relocation_evidence.checkpoint_attestation_payload: domain, tenant, F, checkpoint id, generation, sealed flag, target count, target digest and target max independently canonical_field encoded before HMAC
relocation_evidence.checkpoint_attestation_cross_store: Tier 1 verifier and Timescale issuer produce identical canonical checkpoint payload for same facts
relocation_evidence.projection_writer: ts_automation_owner with projection DML but without checkpoint/key ownership or freeze-disable authority
relocation_evidence.target_signing_key_generation: generated inside Tier 2 target authority using target-side randomness
relocation_evidence.checkpoint_attestation: domain-separated HMAC-SHA-256 over self-delimiting target-owned checkpoint facts
relocation_evidence.preseal_future_row: any target row accepted_ordinal > F makes sealing fail and leaves phase open
relocation_evidence.sealed_phase: all target-history DML rejected and target self-activation without Tier 1 grant returns false
relocation_evidence.tier1_activation_commit: placement transition and exact activation grant committed in one local PostgreSQL transaction; conflict rolls both back
relocation_evidence.target_activation_authority: target verifies exact committed Tier 1 grant and matching placement before sealed-to-activated transition
relocation_evidence.cross_authority_call_order: remote verification before local authority locks; after verification each side performs short local transactional/CAS work only
relocation_evidence.cross_authority_failure_semantics: connection failure, local deadline expiry, disconnect, verifier error or uncertainty returns false/fail-closed
relocation_evidence.evidence_verifier_transport: PostgreSQL asynchronous dblink plus random LOGIN verifier credentials, connect_timeout for setup, caller-local post-connect polling deadlines and restricted capability stores
relocation_evidence.activated_phase: existing history immutable; INSERT eligible only above relocation fence
relocation_evidence.seal_dml_serialization: target DML takes shared target_control authority; seal takes exclusive authority before future-row check and digest

crypto_evidence_boundary.rule: every structured message protected by hash/HMAC must first have deterministic versioned injective or equivalently unambiguous field framing, and each typed value must itself have a total injective canonical representation over the full accepted domain
crypto_evidence_boundary.canonical_encoding: bounded evidence representation using UTF-8 byte-length plus lowercase hex
crypto_evidence_boundary.timestamp_rule: finite timestamptz uses UTC microseconds plus explicit AD/BC era; non-finite uses exact -infinity/infinity
crypto_evidence_boundary.numeric_rule: finite numeric uses trim_scale canonical text; NaN, Infinity and -Infinity use distinct exact reserved literals
crypto_evidence_boundary.target_checkpoint_hmac_sha256: bounded evidence integrity mechanism with effective key generated and retained inside target authority
crypto_evidence_boundary.recovery_grant_hmac_sha256: bounded evidence integrity mechanism over canonical_grant
crypto_evidence_boundary.issuer_verifier_separation: verification capability excludes signing/mint capability; Tier 1 has no target signing key
crypto_evidence_boundary.verifier_secret_isolation: verifier secrets are restricted authority capability state and absent from SQL function source
crypto_evidence_boundary.production_requirement: accepted implementation may use equivalent encoding, typed canonicalization, crypto, recovery identity, verifier transport and secret storage only if independently reviewed evidence preserves deterministic versioning, total/injective full-domain typed representation including finite timestamp-era, timestamp sentinels and numeric NaN/Infinity/-Infinity distinction, unambiguous structured representation, target-originated target-only mint authority, verifier-without-mint capability, secret isolation, single-winner authenticated-principal recovery admission, bounded cross-authority verification, exact activation-grant binding, atomic grant+placement commitment and key isolation

privileged_automation_boundary.production_requirement: connection/authentication admission, pg_hba/socket/network exposure and role-membership policy must prevent tenant/application principals from authenticating as or assuming ts_automation_owner

bounded_capacity_observation.interpretation: Mechanism-level bounded fitness evidence only. Production SLOs, retention, cardinality, sizing, cost and topology remain OPEN-REL-020 C3.

decision_recommendation.tier2: accept TimescaleDB historical projection only under mediated shared history, privileged automation-owner boundary, genuine fresh-cluster role reconstruction, complete target checkpoint equivalence, total/injective full-domain timestamp and numeric canonicalization, target-originated target-only signing authority, no uncheckpointed pre-activation data, exact Tier 1 activation-grant verification, immutable pre-F history after cutover, verifier-secret isolation and bounded cross-authority verification
